from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to, as named in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The financial metric name, e.g., '交易性金融资产'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount for this metric")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency or unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the value")
    is_end_balance: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this value represents an end-of-period balance")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring this metric extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
